updates.name: Clarissa Anderson
updates.bio: Research scientist and academic program manager in the Integrative Oceanography Division at Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego. She directs SCCOOS and the CIMEAS cooperative institute, leads harmful algal bloom observing and early-warning projects such as a statewide Imaging FlowCytobot network, and co-chairs the National HAB Committee.

updates.name: Daniel Doak
updates.bio: Professor and Byers Family Chair in Environmental Studies at the University of Colorado Boulder. He studies how rare species and habitats can be understood and managed, biodiversity conservation, population and community ecology, and how climate change affects ecological systems. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Washington in 1990.
